/--
A mapping from free variable identifiers to values of type `α`.
This is a persistent data structure implemented using `Std.TreeMap`. -/
@[expose] def FVarIdMap (α : Type) := Std.TreeMap FVarId α (Name.quickCmp ·.name ·.name)
